correctness.rationale: An exact rational polyhedral proof over all 3x3 real operators reconstructs all 18 dual vertices, 56 supported positive pairs and 216 operator-norm objective tensors. Every objective is represented exactly by a nonnegative rational combination of signed supporting tensors with total weight <=2; certificate data and standard-library replayer prove norm(T)<=2v(T) without sampling. A diagonal operator has norm 2 and radius 1 exactly. The three-point minimality step is a published theorem.

value.rationale: Smallest possible non-equilateral counterexample to the precisely stated three-point equilateral-rigidity threshold. The four-point single-short-edge ultrametric is a natural structured metric, and its numerical index is a substantive nontrivial invariant not determined by its known facet count or Hilbert distortion; an exact minimal case improves on existing five-point witness, without fabricating a general theorem.
